rumours.text: Mitoglou tore his left hamstring in Greece's 88–92 OT loss to Georgia (26 Nov); out at least until the 11 Dec derby with Olympiacos. Kalaitzakis has a sprained left ankle and is the only one of the two who might make Besiktas.
rumours.impact: Rogkavopoulos and Hayes-Davis pick up the 4-spot minutes at Besiktas on Friday.

rumours.text: Montero (lateral meniscus surgery, 30 Oct) is walking on a treadmill; the estimate is still a May return.
rumours.impact: Fournier and Miller-McIntyre keep the creator minutes through the double week.

rumours.text: Panathinaikos filed two new complaints against Olympiacos and Bartzokas (fan banners and chants; Bartzokas' comments on his fine).
rumours.impact: None for R15: a ban would not change Bartzokas' coach points, which follow the result.

rumours.text: Hifi named EuroLeague MVP of November and says he won't leave Paris this season despite Olympiacos talk.
rumours.impact: No role change; he stays your Thursday captain.

rumours.text: Hapoel move daily operations back to Israel in December but keep hosting EuroLeague games in Sofia.
rumours.impact: Milano's game (Tonut) stays in Bulgaria; no effect.

rumours.text: Procida left Italy's camp with a physical problem (27 Nov). Campazzo (hamstring) was targeting the 3 Dec Clásico; no update today.
rumours.impact: A Campazzo return would trim Maledon's minutes a little; Abalde is unaffected.
